map.输入：单次 250ml、每日目标 2000ml、间隔 60 分钟。\n全天杯数=:
Input: 250 ml per drink, daily goal 2000 ml, interval 60 minutes.
Cups per day=goal/per-drink=2000/250=8 cups; starting from the first cup, one every 60 minutes, the coverage=(8−1)×60=420 minutes≈7 hours.
If the first cup is at 08:00, the reminders are 08:00/09:00/…/14:00, 8 in total.
Conclusion: a 2000 ml daily goal needs 8 drinks of 250 ml, about one per hour, completed within 7 hours.
map.每天一定要喝 2000ml 吗？: Must I drink 2000 ml every day?
map.2000ml 是通用参考值，实际需求随体重、气温、运动量变化（常按 30–35m: 2000 ml is a general reference; actual needs vary with body weight, temperature and activity level (often 30–35 ml/kg). With heavy exercise or hot weather it can reach 3000 ml+; people who restrict fluids (kidney disease, heart failure, etc.) should follow medical advice and not apply this table.
map.一次喝很多和分次喝有区别吗？: Is drinking a lot at once different from drinking in portions?
map.分次少量更利于吸收与肾脏调节，避免血液瞬间稀释与频繁排尿；运动中也建议每 15–: Smaller, more frequent drinks are better for absorption and kidney regulation, avoiding a sudden dilution of the blood and frequent urination; during exercise it is also advisable to drink 150–200 ml every 15–20 minutes rather than gulping when thirsty.
